_comment: Rename this to certificates.json next to the script and it runs as a batch. template and keyLength are defaults any certificate may override. outputFolder is optional - left out, everything lands beside the script.
_names: dnsNames and ipAddresses are JSON arrays: every name in its own quotes, separated by a comma, all inside [ ]. A single string with commas or semicolons in it is accepted too, so "fw-01, fw" works.
